summary: dellemc.openmanage known issues for 10.3.0: the SOCKS proxy and iDRAC8 share limits, the BOSS-N1 false success, the ome_diagnostics export failure on OME 4.0.0 and the duplicate uplink name behavior.
questions: What openmanage issues were known in Ansible 10.3.0?
Does ome_diagnostics fail on OME 4.0.0 in 10.3.0?

answer_card.title: dellemc.openmanage known issues (10.3.0)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `idrac_diagnostics`: no SOCKS proxy export to HTTP/HTTPS shares.
- `idrac_firmware`: no authenticated shares on iDRAC8.
- `idrac_storage_volume`: false success on BOSS-N1 when a virtual disk exists.
- `ome_diagnostics`: SupportAssist export fails on OME 4.0.0.
- `ome_smart_fabric_uplink`: a duplicate name modifies the existing uplink.
